name: Monitor Workspaces
author: Vlad Boca
description: Per-monitor workspaces for multi-monitor setups: each monitor gets its own 1-9, 0, Super+number acts on the focused monitor, and a bar badge shows which monitor has focus.

barWidget.description: Shows the workspaces this monitor owns as 1..9, 0, or a badge that lights up on the focused monitor.
